CrossMux 1.5.6 adds reading backgrounds and guide lines, an online dictionary manager and file editing, and makes WeRead, Inx navigation, and low-memory reading more reliable.

## Reader and customization

- Add configurable reading guide lines, custom PNG reading backgrounds, and PNG image viewing.
- Add custom EPUB auto-turn intervals, keep the reader awake while auto-turning, refine paragraph typography defaults, and add compact TXT paragraph formatting.
- Add an online dictionary manager and file-browser actions for renaming, moving, and deleting files.

## WeRead and interface

- Complete WeRead touch navigation, promote locally opened shelf books, and speed up large shelves by loading visible covers on demand.
- Load Inx covers progressively, speed up tab switching, expand About device details, and improve settings button navigation.
- Add transparent sleep-screen overlays while preserving opaque white pixels in source images.

## Reliability

- Make allocation failures recoverable, harden ZIP and cache deserialization, reuse framebuffer scratch, and prevent EPUB layout, footnote, and reading-stat crashes under low memory.
- Stabilize resumable font downloads, guard against cross-chip firmware installation, and harden credential storage.
- Incorporate upstream fixes through `develop` commit `596f0d3f`, including new X3 display support and lower X3 battery drain.

## Upgrade notes

- Existing books, reading progress, settings, and downloaded WeRead EPUBs are preserved.
- EPUB book cache version remains 11. Section caches advance to version 54 for international builds and 55 for Chinese builds, causing a one-time pagination cache rebuild.
- TXT page indexes advance to version 7. Versions 4 through 6 remain reusable while extra paragraph spacing is enabled.
- WeRead now versions its derived caches. An incompatible cache clears shelf and per-book derived data while preserving the session, accepted disclaimer, completed EPUBs, and normal reader progress.

> **WeRead security notice:** WeRead uses an unofficial Web protocol that may change without notice. Device traffic is encrypted with wolfSSL, but the current client does not verify the server CA or host identity. Use WeRead only on a trusted network.

## Firmware assets

- `firmware.bin` — international firmware
- `firmware-cn.bin` — Simplified Chinese firmware
- `bootloader.bin` and `partitions.bin` — complete web/USB flashing support

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/0x1abin/crossmux/compare/1.5.5...1.5.6
